ops_per_sample: hand count: 1 delay write + ~70 per active voice (2 Hermite reads ~22 flops, windows/wrap ~14, normalise ~6, tone lp) + ~10 level/ratio/pan per voice + ~10 dry/mix = ~90 one voice, ~170 two voices. Host measured 12.7 ns/sample (1 voice, ladder 5 default => voices skipped) / 20.4 ns/sample (two voices, INTVL 11).
notes: Clean standalone rewrite: shared input delay line (2048 floats) + 2 voices of dual crossfading Hermite read heads (SOLAD style), grain G = 2*M*period from ctx.f0 (~20 ms, fallback 24 ms unvoiced); mean latency ~12 ms (<=25). v1 ladder idx 0..12 per V1_SCRAPE 4.1; idx 13 = MANUAL (pure voices at STEP A/B, v1 had no handler). Levels: single 0.6 (dry 1), two 0.5/0.5 + dry 0.5. STEP A/B add to ladder values (+-24 st fine); DETUNE +-cents A/B; GLIDE slews pitch ratio per sample, level changes 10 ms slew (no clicks, tested). Stereo out always. hyperGuitar hg/shifter.cpp was read for ideas only (Bela-coupled), nothing copied. Caveat: without a tracked f0 the 24 ms fallback grain is not period-synchronous: modulation artefacts, pitch ok within ~3% for some inputs, worse (autocorr picks envelope) for others; engine normally supplies f0.
